name: The Bean & Bar
description: The Bean & Bar is a seasonal coffee shop and bar that brings together great coffee, creative drinks and a lively social atmosphere. Our concept moves naturally from specialty coffee and refreshing daytime beverages to cocktails, mocktails and evening meetups.

Rooted in Ehden, North Lebanon, with a seasonal presence in Zgharta at Voda Pool, The Bean & Bar is built around summer gatherings, relaxed moments and memorable events. Our drink selection includes coffee, signature mocktails, cocktails and refreshments, with occasional limited food offerings at events.

highlights.title: Coffee & Refreshments
highlights.text: Coffee, chilled beverages and refreshing drinks for warm days and easygoing meetups.

highlights.title: Cocktails & Mocktails
highlights.text: Colorful signature creations, including fruit-based alcohol-free options and mixed drinks.

highlights.title: Seasonal Atmosphere & Events
highlights.text: Summer openings in Ehden and Zgharta, community festivals and lively social occasions.
